entities.summary: Mamuka Khazaradze is a Georgian politician and entrepreneur. He is the Chairman of Lelo for Georgia, a centrist political party, full member of the ALDE Party in the European Union. Khazaradze co-founded the largest Georgian universal bank, JSC TBC Bank in 1992. He entered politics in 2019, becoming a Member of the Parliament of Georgia in the 2020 parliamentary elections.
